name: whatsapp
description: WhatsApp chat bridge. Mirrors chat.input / chat.response between the brAIn bus and a WhatsApp account (scan a QR from your phone to link, like WhatsApp Web).

default_subscriptions.description: Mirrored to WhatsApp for every known chat (except when the message itself originated from WhatsApp — loop guard via metadata.platform).
Brain (or other node) replies (exact-topic flavor used by the default seed).
Brain (or other node) replies with a sub-topic suffix.
UI control plane — `{action: connect|disconnect|logout|status}`. Triggers reconnect (re-render QR), graceful disconnect, full logout (drop session).

action.description: connect: start socket / re-render QR if unpaired. disconnect: graceful end of the current socket (session kept). logout: drop the WhatsApp session entirely (wipes auth, next connect needs a fresh QR). status: republish current state, QR (if any), and known chats.
